_comment: Case matrix for block-force-push.sh, read by block-force-push.test.sh. The hook is global, so there is no in_scope field. COVERAGE BOUNDARY: this matrix holds only the cases decidable from the command string alone — explicit force flags (hook check 1), `+refspec` tokens (check 2), and compound commands where another command's -f flag must not be read as a force push. The two config-dependent checks — a `+`-prefixed refspec configured in remote.<name>.push (check 3) and git aliases that resolve to a force push (check 4) — need repository git state to assert, so they live in the shell-only section of block-force-push.test.sh.

cases.command: tar -xzf a.tgz && git push origin main
cp -rf a b && git push origin main
